notes.title: High School Dirty Secrets - New DEMO available
notes.content:
[h1] High School Dirty Secrets – Demo Out Now! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032259/b92c8f37dc25902123c986f1e720bddaa6950d95.png[/img]

Kasuga wakes up trapped in her high school, alone—except for the whispers in the dark. The halls twist and shift, shadows creep closer, and something is watching. The truth hides within these walls… but some secrets should stay buried.

Will you escape, or be consumed by the terror? 
[h2]Play the free demo now, if you dare...[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115490/High_School_Dirty_Secrets/
